ctx.x: The only thing was that studio -- the studio worked just like everybody else, they had categories. And I know that if you were a black musician you were a jazz player and you didn't get too much calls to be a lead player. E ie Royal was an exception because he was a great high note player and they always had to have him because he was the best around on that. But it worked both ways. If they were going to have a white guy who played perfectly good jazz and maybe not very good lead, they would call in a black guy…
